diagnosis.entry: requestFor returns undefined until validate consumes the admitted UI lease; the old short-circuit checked requestFor first and therefore returned 403 before discovery.
diagnosis.egress: validate consumes exactly once; invoking it again after discovery would deny a valid completed read.

correction.entry: validate once, then requestFor equality and revalidate
correction.egress: requestFor equality, matchesIntent(context, operation, inputDigest), and revalidate; no second validate

producerContract.matchesIntent: matchesIntent(context: TrustedUiContext, operation: string, inputDigest: string): boolean
producerContract.matchesIntentSemantics: Returns true only for a current consumed admission with the same operation and input digest
producerContract.requestForSemantics: Returns original Request only for a current consumed admission
producerContract.validateSemantics: Rejects consumed admissions and atomically consumes one after asynchronous authority revalidation

verification.method: Static source inspection via GitHub MCP at immutable C9; local source patch only

followUp: The test owner checks the real HTTP response status and parsed catalog before asserting the visible Forecast action; root publishes W2 and controls deduplicated surgical Actions.
